release: Theme 1.32.1 (sitemap: leave out posts whose canonical points elsewhere and the noindex Composer page)
note: Theme only, on production 1.32.0 (release commit 112dd02, main 112dd02). Baseline: the 1.32.0 release manifest (291 files, sha256 b282a689...). Core stays 1.10.0. 3 files, all replaced: inc/learn-composer.php (the /learn/motion/compose/ page, already noindex, is left out of the Slim SEO sitemap), inc/seo.php (a post whose Slim SEO canonical points to another URL is left out of the sitemap; an empty or self canonical changes nothing), and style.css last (version 1.32.1, switch file). Both use the existing slim_seo_sitemap_post_ignore filter (Slim SEO 4.9.11 on production). Only the sitemap changes: no canonical, robots, redirect or page output changes, no new rewrite rule and no database change. Expected on production: 594 sitemap URLs become 592 (the old RTX article in the post sitemap and /learn/motion/compose/ in the page sitemap); every other URL stays. Labs (Code Studio still a draft), Design Library (gate closed), Industry Hub, SVG Motion Studio and Learn stay byte-identical to 1.32.0.

B.check: Existing 101 URLs unchanged from the 1.32.0 state (/sitemap.xml, the page itself and /learn/motion/compose/ included); /sitemap-post-type-post.xml loses exactly the old RTX article and /sitemap-post-type-page.xml exactly /learn/motion/compose/ (594 sitemap URLs become 592, none added, the other sitemaps keep their counts); both pages still answer 200 with the same canonical and robots (compose stays noindex, follow); an unknown URL answers 404; /labs/code-studio/ and /design/ still 404; style.css?ver=1.32.1; all 3 files match the manifest.

after_apply: Do not reset OPcache or purge caches unless separately approved: 1.31.0 to 1.32.0 showed new files are picked up without a reset. If a sitemap still lists the two URLs, recheck later; a sitemap cache purge needs separate approval.
after_rollback: No rewrite rule or database change to undo.
Check the 101 URLs match the 1.32.0 state, style.css?ver=1.32.0 and the sitemaps list the two URLs again (594). Cache purge and OPcache reset only with separate approval.
